parts.t: Browse every condo and apartment for sale in Willoughby, Township of Langley below, at any price, and contact Jared today if you have questions.

These are condos for sale in Willoughby, in the Township of Langley, at any price. The Township rewrote Willoughby's plans in 2026 around a future rapid bus line on 200 Street, and that shapes where new condos go.

On June 15, 2026, Township Council adopted a new Willoughby Community Plan. It created the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan and the Gordon Neighbourhood Plan, and repealed the Carvolth, Jericho, Latimer, Routley and Gordon Estate plans. Yorkson, Smith and Williams kept their own updated plans. That's all on the Township's
community and neighbourhood plans page

One thing for buyers: projects that applied before June 15, 2026 can still go ahead under the old plans until June 15, 2028. So for a couple of years, two sets of rules are in play. When you're looking at a presale, ask which plan it was approved under.
The big idea in the new plan is transit. The Township's
Willoughby Community Plan update

page says TransLink has proposed bus rapid transit along 200 Street, with five stations inside the corridor plan area. Each station is meant to become a neighbourhood hub with more mixed-use building.
The Township is also working on a long-term vision for the area around the Langley Events Centre, called LEC 2040, and did an earlier planning study called 200 Street 2040.

The new Gordon Neighbourhood Plan replaces the Central Gordon Estate and North East Gordon Estate plans. The Township says the goal is to simplify the rules for these growing neighbourhoods and look at room for more homes. If you're comparing condos on both sides of Willoughby, it helps to know which plan each building falls under.
Willowbrook Station, part of the
Surrey Langley SkyTrain
extension, will sit at 196 Street and Fraser Highway, serving Surrey, the Township and the City of Langley. It will have a transit exchange. The Province expects the line to open in
late 2029
. The Township has set a Transit-Oriented Area around Willowbrook, per its
small-scale housing page

Did the Willoughby plan change in 2026?
Yes. On June 15, 2026, the Township adopted a new Willoughby Community Plan and a Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan, and repealed several older neighbourhood plans.
What does the new plan say about 200 Street?
The proposed bus rapid transit line includes five stations within the plan area, each envisioned as a new neighbourhood hub with more intensive mixed-use development.
Is there a SkyTrain station near Willoughby?
Willowbrook Station will be at 196 Street and Fraser Highway, expected to open in late 2029.
Is there a Willoughby-only condo price?
No. FVREB reports Langley as one area.
